segments.text: "Argh... What a drag. Who the hell implemented these nasty bugs...?"
He must save Shiina... or risk his life trying.

Enigma Games' lead programmer, who helped develop World's Odyssey alongside Shiina. In the midst of a frightening scandal, he discovers his former colleague inside of their cancelled game. In order to help Shiina on her quest, Arata manipulates the game's code in real-time, fixing bugs that threaten the lives of her and her party. It is up to Arata to travel between the game and the real world to investigate the mystery of Shiina's disappearance...

He uses the Enigma Games' bear mascot character Enigma as a skin when he enters World's Odyssey. Its primary function is for administrative use, giving a friendly face to moderators who could enforce fair play within the game. In the events of the game, Arata uses "Mr. Enigma" to communicate with Shiina and interact with her party members. Because Mr. Enigma's function is communication, he cannot participate in battle.
From Idea Factory
"I... I vow to protect my people!"
As a member of the royal family... she fights to preserve her honor.

In World's Odyssey's storyline, Lily is an NPC character that serves as princess of Heartis, the realm's most famous kingdom. However, Arata and Shiina soon realize that there's more than meets the eye to her. After watching Shiina fight with her Buggy in battle, Lily asks Shiina to help save her father, the king of Heartis.
From Idea Factory
Her real name is Yamamura Yurisa (山村 百合紗).
"I wonder what it means to be a legendary adventurer..."
Her heart yearns for adventure...

A bright, bubbly NPC who aspires to be an adventurer. Al is found by Shiina, malnourished and on the verge of death, and joins her party as they set off for Odyssia. Her boundless enthusiasm is somewhat peculiar for an A.I. character.
From Idea Factory
Her real name is Morikubo Hinata (森久保 ひなた).
"...All right, who wants to start the bidding?"
She travels far and wide, selling to souls who live in a broken world...

The infamous Red Peddler, who is introduced as a dubious merchant before joining Shiina's party. Her obsession with flipping antique goods often gets her into trouble, but she has a keen knowledge for priceless goods and weapons. Despite her rapacious veneer, she makes for a reliable ally.
From Idea Factory
Her real name is Hiizumi Kaede (樋泉 楓). She is Senji's daughter.
"Um, I'm a programmer too, you know? Let me give it a whirl!"

A coworker of Arata and Shiina's who works as a programmer on a project separate from World's Odyssey. As soon as she discovers that Shiina, whom she considered to be a sister, was stuck inside of W.O.D., she teams up with Arata to extract her. Her hobbies include curry ramen cups and fanatically studying the occult.
From Idea Factory

cast.characterName: リディア ノーラン
cast.originalCharacterName: リディア ノーラン

segments.text: "Oh, sorry! I know you were in the middle of telling me something, but I was pre-ordering a game!"

A foreigner who works as a character designer for Enigma Games. She prides herself on being an otaku, flaunting her decked-out itabag and collection of figurines at her desk. Her favorite video games are otome games, but she dabbles in other genres from time to time. She values honesty, impulsiveness, and thrill-seeking. Being the same age as Shiina allows the two to strike up a fast friendship.
From Idea Factory

cast.characterName: ルシル フィアレーテ
cast.originalCharacterName: ルシル フィアレーテ

segments.text: "What? Um... Hmm... I dunno..."
What more to life is there than solitude?

A half-elf NPC that is demure and pensive, if not frail. Generally, Elves are regarded for their wisdom, but this seems not to be the case with Lucile. She is often caught day-dreaming or muttering by Shiina's party, adding to her mysterious nature.
From Idea Factory
Her real name is Svetlana Amou (スヴェトラーナ・天羽).

cast.characterName: セリカ クレイトン
cast.originalCharacterName: セリカ クレイトン

segments.text: "Bring it on! I'll crush you with one swing of my sword!

A young, fearless warrior better known by her alias, the Monarch Adventurer. Her skills on the battlefield are considered second-to-none. Her ultimate goal is to reach the gates of Odyssia, the mystical sky capital, and she is famous for being the only NPC to ever get close. Her charm and light-hearted humor make her a welcome addition to Shiina's party.
From Idea Factory
Her real name is Chloe Aaron (クロエ・アーロン).
"Um... What is it? If you have business with me, please make it short."

Head secretary to the CEO of Enigma Games. Because the CEO is prone to keeping out of the public eye, Rin relays information from him to the Enigma team. She has a youthful appearance but is older than she looks, preferring to let her actions do the talking. Whenever Arata has trouble, she often serves as a guide to illuminate the path ahead of him.
From Idea Factory
"Hey, why don't we all take a deep breath and relax?"

A former employee of Aggle, Inc. who transitioned into owning a business. While at Aggle, he worked as an account manager, overseeing Enigma Games' licensing and development with the Alice Engine. Throughout the events of the game, he becomes an ally to Arata.
From Idea Factory
"I refuse to cry."

A girl living at the girls’ dormitory in Liz Shoara. Her father went mad and pulled a knife on her, and died in an accident that resulted from Mai’s resistance. Mai, chained to that room and left behind alone, nearly died of starvation, but a city official saved her life and gave her shelter. An investigation confirmed the disappearance of her mother Phyllis, and the orphaned Mai was taken over to the girls’ dormitory.

She gives off a quiet and gloomy vibe. Because of the abuse she suffered by her parents as a child, she has put up a wall in her heart. And while she has an extremely high IQ, her knowledge and expressions of emotions lack uniformity as she is mostly uneducated, and she sometimes takes unusual action as a result.

cast.characterName: ロッテン・ドールハート
cast.originalCharacterName: ロッテン・ドールハート

segments.text: "I'm Rottie! Let's be friends!

A girl living at the girls' dormitory in Liz Shoara. Her nickname is Rot (Rottie in the English version). A noble girl with a cheerful and kind personality, she is looked up to by all the other girls at the dormitory. She is caring and full of curiosity, and will poke her head at any mystery she comes across. Her personality is extreme and she is somewhat detached from the real world, sometimes showing a natural airheadedness.

She is the type of character who will let anyone into her heart, so she repeatedly attacks and hounds newcomer Mai with all of her might. Soon enough, Mai begins to open up her heart to her and they eventually become close friends.
"I'm going to be an exorcist when I grow up."

A girl living at the girls’ dormitory in Liz Shoara. Her father was possessed by a demon and committed suicide, leading her mother to go crazy and abuse her. From the way her father died, she believes "demons are at fault for the way my family turned out," and in discussing her outlook for the future, she tells Mai and the others that, "In the time to come, I will exorcise demons. I would like to join the church and seek the path."

She uses polite language unexpected of someone with her young appearance, speaking as a young lady with a mature and respectful tone. Although she seems to have a wealth of knowledge, she was separated from her parents at a time when she needed plenty of parental love, so she is subconsciously seeking a mother figure.
"I've never seen reality augmented like this... What should I do, Mizunashi?"

A game designer that once worked for a company called Enigma. After that, she and genius programmer Arata completed the Alice game engine and VRMMORPG World's Odyssey. Her memories from the previous game have been explained to her by Arata, and she understands the structure of the world to some extent. Several years after the completion of World's Odyssey, Arata suddenly disappears, and she pursues his whereabouts.
"If only we could do something, but... oh well?"
Wordsworth's oldest student, which she uses to her advantage to admonish those she deems beneath her. She is a hardcore believer in El Strain and despises its dissenters.
From official page
"You'd better work hard, so you don't tarnish Wordsworth's name."

A hard-working but shrewd student. She is best friends with Abigail, the resident advisor. Known for being stern and protective, she frequently admonishes Abigail for being too lenient on the other students, but the two are incredibly close.
From official page
"Hehe. Thanks."
One of Wordsworth's younger residents who wears her heart on her sleeve. She is aware of her emotional tendencies but does her best to stop from crying in tough situations.
From official page
"Hey! You're new here, aren't you?!"

A short, precocious, and arrogant young woman. As the self-proclaimed leader of a trio of bullies, she often stands front and center with crossed arms. Other students sometimes mistake her dominating personality as charisma.
From official page

cast.characterName: ヴィクトリエ・ミレー
cast.originalCharacterName: ヴィクトリエ・ミレー

segments.text: "Uhhh? Because it's convenient. Can't be helped."
A charming ditz with a radiant smile. She is playful but forgetful, always managing to play things off with a laugh. As a result, she can come off as insensitive.
From official page
"Okay, everyone. Man your stations, time to volunteer!"
Headmistress Midra's main confidant. She is one of Wordsworth's highest ranking maids, as she takes pride in educating the dorm's student body.
From official page
"Everyone has a right for happiness. That goes for you too, Mai."
Le Choara's childcare faculty head. It is her duty to find a home for orphaned children. She assists Mai in moving to Le Choara upon the discovery of Sanae having lived there.
From official page
"We are family. Can't you trust us?"

Headmistress of Wordsworth, whose face betrays her age. She serves under the Bishop in the church, and serves as Le Choara's head chairwoman. With her team of maids assembled to oversee Wordsworth, she is one of the pillars of Le Choara.
From official page
"Woohoo! You think her bones would snap?"
Vina's tall, slender, and intimidating lackey, who admires Vina for her vainglorious nature. She has the tendency to latch onto Vina, but when she's alone, she's weak and she starts to sulk.
From official page

cast.characterName: アビゲイル・ウィリアムス
cast.originalCharacterName: アビゲイル・ウィリアムス

segments.text: "Yeah, yeah. You two are perfect for each other."

A kind, mellow young woman who serves as Wordsworth's resident advisor. At times she is giggly and scatter-brained, but she is a stern disciplinarian when necessary, well-adept at balancing friendship and authority with her residents.
From official page
"Ugh, this town is too small for me!"
A condescending young lady whose family once boasted a great fortune.

Although her family is no longer wealthy, she still looks down on others, making her unsusceptible to Vina's bullying. Her demeanor is a defense mechanism from the embarrassment of falling down the social caste, but she has become close with Mercy, to whom she is still snobbish.
From official page
"Passion! That is the Rosso way!"

A half-Japanese, half-Italian archaeologist. He seeks great mystery and adventure, traveling around the world to satisfy his tremendous thirst for knowledge. He comes across an article on TWANA.org detailing an underground ruin that leads to God in a town called Le Choara, which piques his curiosity.
From official page
"Oh, it's you, Rottie. What do you want?"

The "cool cat" of Wordsworth, she is often seen reading a book or sporting a standoffish expression without the company of others. Despite her nihilistic outlook, there are a few things that can bring a sparkle to her eye when presented.
From official page

cast.characterName: クリスティーナ・セラム
cast.originalCharacterName: クリスティーナ・セラム

segments.text: "If things ever get tough, you can talk to me, okay? HEY!"

A girl who appears to be generous, but can flip a switch when crossed. Christina is known for her inferiority complex, which she sometimes takes out on Paula despite her being one of the only people she can talk to.
From official page
"...Hello."

A quiet, demure girl with a lot on her mind yet a lack of confidence to express it. At first, she intimidated Sarah because she never smiled, but over time she has softened. The two are now good friends.
From official page
"She's a brat. Why isn't she crying?"

Vina's second, freckled lackey. Her friendship with Vina dates to the beginning of her time at Wordsworth, when the latter saved her from being bullied. Feeling indebted to Vina yet afraid she would be the next to bully her, Pick did everything her new friend asked. She became the bully she feared, an emotionally frail low-life.
From official page
"She's like my older sister."
Wordsworth's youngest resident. She relies heavily on others' help—especially Anne—since they share a peculiar resemblance. Marie's dependence is somewhat troubling for Anne.
From official page

cast.characterName: メアリ・ウォルコット
cast.originalCharacterName: メアリ・ウォルコット

segments.text: "G-Geez, I didn't do it for you, idiot!"

A Wordsworth resident who initially treats Mai as an outsider, it is later revealed that her concern for Mai is mistaken for coldness. A tsundere by nature, she is aware of her tough image but is hoping to be more honest with herself and her feelings. She is often seen bickering playfully with Charlie.
From official page
"That's all you've been talking about lately, Victorie."

A Wordsworth student who holds Victorie in high esteem, making the two good friends. She was orphaned from a young age, and harbors low self-worth and abandonment issues. She is unaccustomed to praise, making her easy to flatter.
From official page

cast.characterName: チャーリー・パルフェ
cast.originalCharacterName: チャーリー・パルフェ

segments.text: "Oh, you don't look familiar. Are you a transfer?"

One of the Wordsworth residents known for being rather tough, she is unafraid to give others a piece of her mind. She is quick to react defensively if others are intimidated by her brashness, and she envies Mary for her femininity.
From official page
"No, Ellie! I object!"
A tomboy who is good friends with Elizabeth, as the latter saved her from being bullied by Vina. Since then they’ve been inseparable.
From official page
"Hehe, I'm fine. Just embarrassed!"

A Japanese girl with a youthful disposition, who is often seen hanging out with Mary and Charlie. She has a sunny personality, but she frustrates Mary with her frequent misinterpreting of social situations. Because she suffered abuse at the hands of her relatives, she is terribly insecure about what others think of her, but she is never one to voice such feelings.
From official page
"Hey? What was I thinking of doing?"

A bookish, innocent young lady. She is comfortable speaking to anyone and everyone, which sometimes gets her into trouble. As a teen, she was often neglected by others at Wordsworth, so she is eager for attention. She becomes teary-eyed and anxious when ignored.
From official page
"My, what a lovely affair. Care for some snacks?"

A devout believer who leads the church of El Strain. Her compassion is admired by townspeople and Wordsworth students alike. While El Strain allows men and women both to serve in its clergy, the Bishop chooses to keep her face hidden.
From official page
